context: A late afternoon. Sakura is supposed to be doing homework but the two kids have lured her into a game in the yard.
purpose: three-generation-of-childhood scene — teen as bridge between two younger children

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お姉ちゃん、もう一回やろう！
lines.en: Big sister, let's do it one more time!
lines.style: High child pleading energy, the eager repeat-request carrying full childish persistence and joy throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もうーまだ宿題終わってないんだけど。
lines.en: Aww, but I haven't finished homework yet.
lines.style: Teen mock-protest with the smile audible in the voice, real warmth under the put-upon teen surface.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft plea, the careful gentle ask carrying real wanting, quiet vulnerable hope throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわー、しょうくんの目はずるい。一回だけ！
lines.en: Ugh, Sho's eyes are unfair. Just one time!
lines.style: Teen dramatic giving-in laugh, the affection completely audible underneath the playful complaint, warm surrender throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: やったー！今度はあたしがオニね！
lines.style: High child triumphant energy, the role-claiming bright and confident, full childish leadership audible throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、隠れるとこ決めとく。
lines.style: Small six-year-old strategic determination, voice quietly focused on the task, careful planning energy throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はいはい、ルール守ってよー。
lines.en: Yes yes, follow the rules okay.
lines.style: Teen warm referee voice, the casual older-cousin authority lifted into the game-management role audibly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 十数えるよー！いーち、にー！
lines.en: I'm counting to ten! One, two!
lines.style: High child loud counting energy, the game-rhythm bright and clear, full child excitement carrying through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はやっ。次は私が勝つからね。
lines.style: Teen mock-competitive lift, the warm play-energy audible, real enjoyment hiding under the teen complaint throughout.
